topology: one physical host; primary, asynchronous physical standby, and isolated PITR restore containers

replication.promotion: explicit pg_ctl promote after primary crash injection

archive.basebackup: PostgreSQL 18 pg_basebackup plain format with streamed WAL and SHA256 backup manifest

restore.network_scope: isolated module test route; never a production writer route
before_writer_open: zero effect intent and plugin statistic run side effects

module_measurements.rpo_oracle: durable marker present after asynchronous replay and promotion
module_measurements.failover_rto: measured from crash injection through promotion/readback
module_measurements.pitr_rto: measured from restore start through exact target and incarnation rotation
module_measurements.measurement_claim: observed-only; not an Owner-frozen production SLO

qualification_limit: single failure domain and no automatic failover; never production-ha qualified
result_policy: operational recovery gates may PASS while production qualification remains HOLD/NOT_QUALIFIED
